QuestInfo.name: Potion of Truth
QuestInfo.1: The #rrecipe for Potion of Truth#k has appeared in the book, but you could swear it was blank before. #bSomething weird's going on here...#k You should probably take the book to #b#m307000110:##k for now.
QuestInfo.0: When you finally return from the mission by yourself, you discover #b#p2560111:##k reading something. Clearly he just wanted you around to do his work for him!\r\nBut wait! He's reading the book with the primrose entry!
QuestInfo.2: The new Potion of Truth entry in the book said it "clears falsehood to reveal truth." It's most likely someone pulling a prank, but you're sure it's got your handwriting!
